description: This file contains utility classes, functions, and constants for interacting with the Google Gemini language model API, including environment validation, model retrieval, error handling, token counting, and serialization of complex data types.

classes.name: GeminiError
classes.description: Custom exception class for Gemini-related errors, inheriting from BaseLLMException.

classes.name: GeminiModelInfo
classes.description: Class encapsulating methods to validate environment, retrieve models, and handle model-specific parameters for Gemini API integration.

classes.name: GoogleAIStudioTokenCounter
classes.description: Token counter implementation for Google AI Studio provider, with methods to determine if token counting API should be used and to perform token counting asynchronously.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates or returns the provided headers for environment setup.

methods.name: str api_version(self)
methods.description: Property returning the API version used.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_api_base(api_base: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL, either from input, secret store, or default.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_api_key(api_key: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves the API key, checking input and secret store.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_base_model(model: str)
methods.description: Strips the 'gemini/' prefix from a model name.

methods.name: List[str] process_model_name(self, models: List[Dict[str, str]])
methods.description: Processes a list of models to return Gemini-formatted model names.

methods.name: List[str] get_models( self, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Fetches available models from Gemini API endpoint.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Returns an appropriate error class instance based on API response.

methods.name: Optional[BaseTokenCounter] get_token_counter(self)
methods.description: Factory method to create a token counter for the Gemini provider.

methods.name: Dict[str,object] encode_unserializable_types( data: Dict[str, object], depth: int = 0 )
methods.description: Converts unserializable types within a dictionary to JSON-compatible representations.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_api_key_from_env()
methods.description: Retrieves API key from environment secrets.

methods.name: bool should_use_token_counting_api( self, custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Determines if token counting API should be used based on provider.
